header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ali Bux Talpur, advocate for the petitioners
Through this petition, the petitioner seeks directions to the respondents for
regularization of his service and release of his salaries.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that whatever period the petitioner worked
with the department, his salary be released. The respondents Nos.4, 5 and 6 in their
comments have stated that the salary of the petitioner is to be paid by the Federal
In view of the above situation, this petition is disposed of with directions to
respondent No.4 to hear the petitioner and resolve his grievance strictly in accordance
with law within a period of 30 days.
A copy of this order be communicated to respondent No.4, learned A.A.G and
body: learned D.A.G for information and compliance. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
